tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find no-KYC services by name, website domain or description, optionally within one category. Returns each match with its KYC level, Privacy and Safety grades and incident count.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full listing for one service: KYC level and what the terms say about ID, Privacy and Safety grades with the points behind them, features and warnings, fees and limits, and every recorded incident with its source. Answers "is X safe / legit / a scam / no-KYC?".

tools.name: rank_category
tools.description: The best-graded services in one category, sorted by Safety (default) or Privacy, with services that never or rarely ask for ID first and those whose terms let them demand ID (KYC level 3) after them. Services that require ID from every user are left out, as on the site. Optionally keep only services

tools.name: compare_services
tools.description: Side-by-side grades, KYC levels and incident counts for two listed services.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Recorded incidents (held funds, hacks, exit scams, shutdowns, policy changes), newest first, each with its public source. Optionally for one service.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category with its key, page, number of live listings and the feature keys rank_category accepts for it.
